role: RecoveryScoreCalculator display helpers for a composite score: displayScore (raw 0-100 → shown Int, delegating to ScoreVerdict.safeDisplayScore) and toTenScale (0-100 → stored 0-10). The composite itself comes from calculateWithBreakdown; the former calculate(...) entry points were removed once nothing called them.

units.does: Raw 0-100 score → the Int a person sees, by delegating to ScoreVerdict.safeDisplayScore (clamp to 0...100, non-finite → 0, rounded). Calculator-side name for the one clamp, used by score views, PDF and assistant facts.

flags.text: The clamp now lives only in ScoreVerdict.safeDisplayScore (displayScore delegates), but DeterministicIntent still renders factor scores with a raw Int(factor.score.rounded()), which traps on a non-finite value.
flags.found: second read; narrowed when displayScore was made to delegate

units.does: Divides a 0-100 score by 10 for storage in session.recoveryScore (no clamp).
